summary: NatWest Group plc filed a Form 6-K furnishing a London Stock Exchange announcement dated 11 September 2026 detailing daily purchases of its own ordinary shares over 8-10 September 2026. The company bought shares on the LSE, CHIX and BATE venues through UBS AG, London Branch, with volume-weighted average prices ranging from roughly 682.7p to 690.9p per share. Purchases form part of the existing buyback programme instructed to UBS on 16 February 2026. Repurchased shares will be cancelled. Watch execution pace, treasury share count and any extension or upsizing of the programme.
